# Realtime

WebSockets: a Realtime service, a hibernating Room Durable Object, a useRoom hook and a dashboard card.

Id `extras/realtime`. It is one of the Extras: a project can have any number of them. Template: [`templates/extras/realtime/`](../../templates/extras/realtime/).

## What it is for

WebSocket rooms. Each room is a Durable Object (`Room`) that hibernates while idle. On the server, the `Realtime` service connects clients, broadcasts to a room and counts its connections; in the UI, the `useRoom` hook joins a room.

## Add it

When you create the project:

```sh
npx -y create-efforge my-app --yes --extras=realtime
```

Add it to an existing project:

```sh
npx -y create-efforge add extras/realtime
```

## Needs

- The Cloudflare runtime, which every project has today.

## Conflicts with

Nothing.

## Service and layer

Your code asks for `Realtime`, declared in `packages/core/src/realtime.ts`. Its members:

- `connect(roomId, request)`. Forwards a WebSocket upgrade request to the room; the response completes the handshake. Fails with `RealtimeError`.
- `broadcast(roomId, message)`. Sends `message` to every client connected to the room. Fails with `RealtimeError`.
- `connections(roomId)`. Number of clients currently connected to the room. Fails with `RealtimeError`.

`RealtimeLive` implements it, and `efforge add` puts it in `AppLayer` in `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`.

- To test code that uses `Realtime`, give it a test layer: `Layer.succeed(Realtime, Realtime.of({ ... }))`. See [Swap a layer to test](../testing.md).
- To change the provider, write another layer for `Realtime` and use it in `layers.ts` in place of `RealtimeLive`.

## Files it edits

`efforge add` makes these edits with AST transforms (changes to the parsed code, not to its text), so it changes only what is listed and leaves the rest of each file alone.

### `packages/core/src/index.ts`

- Re-exports everything from `./realtime`.

### `apps/web/src/server.ts`

- Exports `Room` from `./realtime/Room`.

### `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`

- Adds `RealtimeLive` to `AppLayer`, imported from `./realtime`.

### `apps/web/src/server/routes.ts`

- Adds `realtimeRoute` to `workerRoutes`.

### `apps/web/src/server/realtime-route.ts`

- Adds `requireSocketSession` to `upgradeGuards`. Only with `auth=better-auth` or `auth=better-auth-orgs`.

### `wrangler.jsonc`

- Adds a `durable_objects.bindings` entry: `{"name":"ROOM","class_name":"Room"}`. Only with `infra=none`.
- Adds a `migrations` entry: `{"tag":"realtime-v1","new_sqlite_classes":["Room"]}`. Only with `infra=none`.

### `infra/alchemy.run.ts`

- Declares `room` and binds it to the Worker as `ROOM`. Only with `infra=alchemy`.

### `AGENTS.md`

- Adds the rules under [Rules it adds to AGENTS.md](#rules-it-adds-to-agentsmd).

### `apps/web/src/server/realtime-demo.ts`

- Runs `requireSession` before every server function in the file. Only with `auth=better-auth-orgs` or `auth=better-auth`.

### `apps/web/src/capabilities/registry.ts`

- Adds `realtime` to `capabilities`.

### `efforge.jsonc`

- Records the add-on in the stack and the hashes of the files it wrote.

## Rules it adds to AGENTS.md

### Realtime

- Rooms are a Durable Object (`Room`, exported from `apps/web/src/server.ts`); WebSocket upgrades are handled by a Worker route in `server/routes.ts`.
- Use the `Realtime` service from `@repo/core` on the server and the `useRoom` hook in `apps/web/src/lib/use-room.ts` in the UI.
- Keep message payloads small and validate incoming messages with `Schema` before using them.
- Access: with auth, `realtime-route.ts` runs its `upgradeGuards` first, and `requireSocketSession` closes a socket without a session with 4401 "Not signed in" (`useRoom` reports `refused`). Without auth the list is empty and anyone who can reach the app can join a room and read it.
- `useRoom` sends a ping as soon as a socket opens. The room counts and sends only to sockets that have pinged, and closes one that has not 10 seconds after the handshake (a client that left mid-handshake).
